title: Beyond AI Literacy: A Structured Review and Exploratory Meta-Analysis of Measures for Competent Generative-AI Use
abstract: arXiv:2609.15624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Researchers assessing competent generative-AI use at work must choose among self-reports, objective tests, and measures of oversight and reliance. We conducted a structured, seeded review of 24 focal empirical publications, starting from the 2024 COSMIN-based review and adding a targeted update through 17 August 2026. We grouped the measures into four domains: knowledge and use, epistemic oversight, reliance calibration, and operational control of tool-using agents. In an exploratory meta-analysis, we pooled three direct subjective-objective correlations from one research program (REML r = .055; Hartung-Knapp 95% CI [-.047, .156]; combined reported N = 2,765). We could not resolve a discrepancy between the largest study's reported correlation and p-value, leaving its weight uncertain. translated_title: 超越AI素养：胜任生成式AI使用的测量工具结构化综述与探索性元分析
translated_abstract: 在评估工作中的胜任生成式AI使用时，研究人员必须在自我报告、客观测试以及监督与依赖测量之间做出选择。我们进行了一项结构化、种子化的综述，涵盖24篇核心实证出版物，从2024年基于COSMIN的综述出发，并增加了截至2026年8月17日的针对性更新。我们将这些测量工具分为四个领域：知识与使用、认知监督、依赖校准以及对工具使用型智能体的操作控制。在探索性元分析中，我们汇总了来自同一研究项目的三个直接主客观相关系数（REML r = .055；Hartung-Knapp 95%置信区间 [-.047, .156]；合并报告样本量N = 2,765）。我们无法解决最大规模研究报告的相关系数与p值之间的差异，使其权重存在不确定性。在加入来自第四项研究的12个跨因子相关系数的合成均值后，得到r = .079（95%置信区间 [-.025, .181]）。这一敏感性分析涉及一个……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本结构化综述与探索性元分析对胜任生成式AI使用的测量工具进行了系统梳理，发现主观自我报告与客观测试之间仅存在微弱相关性（r≈0.055-0.079），提示现有测量方法间的收敛效度有限。
en_tdlr: This structured review and exploratory meta-analysis of measures for competent generative-AI use identifies four measurement domains and reveals only weak correlations (r≈.055-.079) between subjective self-reports and objective tests, indicating limited convergent validity among existing assessment approaches.
